$comment: Persian product-name suggestions for the invoice-row «نام کالا» autocomplete in Zarlio. Vocabulary collected 2026-10-08 from category/product titles of Iranian gold shops and marketplaces seen via web search (digistyle, digikala mag, kia-gallery, parasteh, haghanigold, bazaretala, saatchico, rubygold, digizargar, miladzar, mavigoldgallery, eligoldgallery, zomorodi, milli.gold, technolife, torob, parsisgold and others; see docs/research/PRODUCT_NAMES_DATASET.md). Terms = product type + audience/style/chain/stone/motif/colour qualifiers that appear in those listings, plus coin and bullion names. No prices, weights or karats (except coin/bar denominations), no brand names (کارتیه/کارتیر kept only as the bazaar chain/bracelet style name). Normalised: ی/ک, ZWNJ, 2–5 words. w = 1–100 heuristic popularity weight (editorial estimate, not measured sales data); sorted by w desc. Generated by a curated script; edit by hand or regenerate, keep sorted and deduplicated.
